title: Lost Then Found Ministries
tagline: Open the Word. Live the Journey.
mission: Free biblical resources to equip pastors and encourage everyday Christians to read God’s Word.
devotionals_intro: Explore God's Word one book at a time with A Journey Through the Bible. This devotional series is designed to help you read, understand, and apply Scripture in your everyday life. Download each devotional for free or purchase a paperback edition through Amazon.
